title: Applicatin of Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company (l) under provisions of G.L. c. 164, sec. 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 199, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly Fuel Charge to be billed to the Company's customers, pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of November and December, 1989 and January, 1990. The Fuel Charge reflects changes in prudently incurred, reasonable costs of fuel and power purchased by the Company; and (2) for approval by the Department, and implement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of the Public Utilities Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
